page.overview:
What is Clanbook: Assamite?

Clanbook: Assamite is a sourcebook for the Assamite clan for Vampire: The Masquerade.

Unlike previous Clanbooks, this chapter starts with an internal letter between two members of the Society of Leopold. There is a excerpt of a CIA report, a excerpt of a religious text which has lines underlined, and an excerpt from the book [https://www.amazon.com/Thirty-North-West-Frontier-Leslie-Mallam/dp/0199063036 Memoirs of the North-West Frontier].

General history of the the clan. How they began, their golden age, their conflict with the Camarilla, and what their status was at the time of this sourcebooks writing. There is a copy of the Treaty of Tyre, 1496, its wording and what is thought about it in practical terms.

This chapter deals talks about becoming an Assamite, the training , the Clan structure, and the Khabar. The Path of Blood is introduced. There is a section for Clan treasures. There are new Assamite specific Merits and Flaws. Elder Quietus powers are given as well as Thaumaturgy Rituals specifically used by the Clan. There is a section detailing an optional combat system, Secondary abilities specifically for Assamite characters and New Weapons used by Assamites. Finally the chapter ends with some advice about Assamite Characters relationship with non-Assamite characters.
